questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase 'Only after the meeting' in the context of starting the project.
options: Only after the meeting did they begin the project.
Only after the meeting have they begun the project.
Only after the meeting were they beginning the project.
Only after the meeting do they begin the project.
questions.answer: Only after the meeting did they begin the project.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific number of attendees at the conference?
options: It was 500 attendees that made the conference so successful.
500 attendees were the ones that made the conference so successful.
The conference was made so successful by 500 attendees.
So successful was the conference because of 500 attendees.
questions.answer: It was 500 attendees that made the conference so successful.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly completes the sentence with a third conditional structure, indicating a hypothetical situation in the past that did not occur.
options: If I had known about the deadline earlier, I would have submitted the report on time.
If I knew about the deadline earlier, I would have submitted the report on time.
If I had known about the deadline earlier, I would submit the report on time.
If I had known about the deadline earlier, the report would have been submitted on time.
questions.answer: If I had known about the deadline earlier, the report would have been submitted on time.

questions.question: Which sentence accurately demonstrates the use of the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement?
options: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attends the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attending the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members is attending the meeting.
questions.answer: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.

questions.question: Identify the correctly formed sentence that uses ellipsis appropriately, maintaining grammatical coherence and meaning in the context of the previous sentence.
options: She said she would come, but then she didn't show up.
She said she would come, but then she didn't showing up.
She said she would come, but then she didn't to show up.
She said she would come, but then she didn't shown up.
questions.answer: She said she would come, but then she didn't show up.
